revisions.task: Investigate a reported compatibility regression in the public request type interface: some valid caller-provided header objects are rejected even though normal request execution should continue to accept them. Make the smallest compatible change without altering runtime request behavior. Update only src/requests/models.py and src/requests/_types.py.
revisions.rationale: The original task disclosed the mutability policy that the predecessor decision should contribute; the revised task states the observable compatibility report and preserves the same source and writable scope.

revisions.task: Investigate a compatibility report involving non-ASCII credentials passed through the public Basic-auth helpers. Add a supported capability while preserving existing callers' behavior. Update only src/urllib3/util/request.py.
revisions.rationale: The original task named the encoding, opt-in mechanism, default behavior, and affected helper paths that the predecessor decision should instead resolve; the revised task keeps the user-visible report and bounded scope.
